intro: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is famous for spicy, Southern-style fried chicken, the viral Chicken Sandwich, handcrafted tenders and Cajun sides like red beans and rice and Cajun fries. Combos pair your main with a side, a biscuit and a drink. Below is the full Popeyes menu with prices and calories for 2026, organized by category.
quick_answer: Popeyes' famous Classic or Spicy Chicken Sandwich is about $5.29, or $8.99 as a combo with a side and drink. Bonafide fried chicken runs about $5.99 for 2 pieces up to $29.99 for a 12-piece box, and 3-piece handcrafted tenders are around $5.49. Sides like Cajun fries and red beans and rice are about $3.29.
hot_deal: Popeyes value: the Classic and Spicy Chicken Sandwiches stay around $5.29, and the Bigger Box (6 tenders with two sides and a biscuit) is about $20 to feed two. Popeyes also runs app-only deals and free-delivery offers through the year. Offers vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is the Popeyes chicken sandwich?
faqs.a: The Classic and Spicy Chicken Sandwiches are about $5.29 each, or $8.99 as a combo with a regular side and a drink. Each sandwich is around 700 calories.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Classic and Spicy at Popeyes?
faqs.a: They cost the same and have the same crispy fillet and pickles. The Spicy version adds a cayenne-based spicy sauce. Both are roughly 700 calories.
Popeyes sides include Cajun fries, red beans and rice, mac and cheese, mashed potatoes with Cajun gravy, coleslaw and the famous buttermilk biscuits, mostly around $3.29 (biscuit $1.19).

faqs.q: How much are Popeyes family meals?
faqs.a: An 8-piece chicken family meal is about $26.99, 12-piece about $39.99 and 16-piece about $49.49, each with large sides and biscuits. Tenders family meals are priced the same.
Handcrafted tenders are about $5.49 for 3 pieces and $7.99 for 5 pieces. A 3-piece tenders combo with a side, biscuit and drink is around $10.09.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Popeyes?
faqs.a: The best known are the Spicy Chicken Sandwich, Bonafide bone-in fried chicken, handcrafted tenders, red beans and rice, and the buttermilk biscuits.
